kevin: alert from audit-scan: some logs forwarded to partners include KMS resource path projects/redwood-prod/locations/global/keyRings/edge/cryptoKeys/ingest-edge-key. need triage.

maya: saw it. forwarded entries = 5 lines to external index. probably from debug dump.

leo: quick check: KMS audit shows only expected decrypts by svc-edge-ingest. no unknown decrypts. still should treat as exposure.

kevin: immediate actions: (1) stop external forwarding for matching patterns, (2) add temporary decrypt binding if any failures, (3) rotate key and rewrap ciphertexts, (4) scan backups for the path and scrub.

vault-bot: vault-audit-forwarder flagged 5 entries containing "/keyRings/edge/cryptoKeys/ingest-edge-key" forwarded externally. Recommend redaction and rotation.

maya: disabling forwarder now.

maya: disabled at 09:04 UTC.

leo: i'll create new key version and prepare a rewrap script with dry-run. will use alias switch in Vault to minimize downtime.

kevin: also add a Conftest rule in infra CI: any terraform diff touching KMS or project IAM must include full-principals list or fail. prevents partial removals.

maya: will prototype the rule.

oncall-bot: incident created: INC-2026-1400 - "edge-kms-path-exposed" assigned to oncall.

kevin: owners: leo (rewrap + rotation), maya (CI gate + forwarder change), kevin (backup scan + partner advisory). update ticket when done.

leo: starting dry-run rewrap now. will report back.
